reason: I independently read all four pinned files in full, verified their hashes and line counts and checked all seven quotations. required_changes: Put the version-specific request warning into the mapped source assessment, findings and Q2. Current source lines 34 and 39 and Korea concept line 107 present the May manual payment_method_types instruction (old raw lines 43-50, 72-75, 98-102 and 134-156). The separate Checkout and Intent changelogs state that the 2026-09-30.endive Checkout Session create and PaymentIntent create endpoints reject this writable field with HTTP 400. The Intent error code is payment_method_types_no_longer_supported. Preserve dynamic-method and allowed_payment_method_types alternatives with compatibility filtering and distinguish the computed response field. Use raw/stripe-changelog-endive-2026-09-30-remove-payment-method-types-checkout-sessions-2026-11-07.md:5-23 and raw/stripe-changelog-endive-2026-09-30-removes-the-payment-method-types-parameter-from-payment-intents-and-setup-intents-2026-11-07.md:5-24,28,34-36. The linked Endive endpoints and REST table bound the claim despite the Intent Impact section's different preview label. Preserve the May examples as dated and the November acceptance index as navigation only. Do not infer Naver Pay eligibility from the generic version migration.

Qualify the funding control in the findings, Q2 and source assessment. The May guide's card default and points alternative belong to method creation in the server example at old raw lines 134-156, while the browser example sends only the method type at old raw lines 254-273. The separate 2025-03-31.basil changelog says existing Naver Pay PaymentMethod parameters cannot be changed on PaymentMethod#update and can be set only at creation (raw/stripe-changelog-basil-2025-03-31-naver-pay-payment-method-2026-11-07.md:5-25). Add that versioned identity/action distinction so a reader does not treat the summary's funding field as editable on an existing instrument. Keep the uncertainty about whether the server's initial option is carried through the separate browser request, and keep funding distinct from the save/reuse path.

Make Q1's historical Direct API flow self-contained. The merchant embeds the required NICEPAY text and terms link on its own checkout page (old raw lines 229-234). Stripe.js confirmation initiates the redirect, and the buyer selects an issuer and authorizes on the local processor page (old raw lines 235-255). Identify the returned payment_intent and payment_intent_client_secret as status-check inputs, and name payment_intent.succeeded as the event used for post-payment actions in the dated guide (old raw lines 282-297). The current answer's browser 'displays the dated NICEPAY disclosure' conflates a merchant page prerequisite with what the SDK performs. Retain the test-state and fulfillment boundary and the route-specific status evidence.
